extracted.strategy: An actively managed ETF that sells (writes) call options on broad U.S. equity index ETFs to generate weekly income distributions while maintaining exposure to high-dividend U.S. equities through the Akros U.S. High Dividend Index, targeting an annualized distribution rate two times the Reference Index's dividend yield.
extracted.notes: Structurally notable for its deliberate straddle-rule avoidance strategy: the fund limits overlap between its High Dividend Portfolio (Reference Index constituents) and the Reference Assets underlying written call options to below 70%, aiming to preserve qualified dividend income treatment. Targets weekly distributions at 2x the Reference Index yield. Non-diversified classification. Tax characterization of distributions is not guaranteed; ROC distributions are explicitly contemplated. Strategy separates the income-generating options overlay (written on broad market ETFs) from the equity portfolio (high-dividend U.S. stocks), which is an increasingly common but still nuanced structure for QDI optimization in covered call ETFs.
